title: 6 months. No label. Too scared to ask.
caption: Six months, no label, and Capricorn is on draft seven of the talk agenda. Wanting to know where you stand is fair. Ask with curiosity, not a deadline. Send this to the friend rehearsing the talk in the mirror.
